subject: Final acceptance latch & eSign sequencing (Stellar Solutions)
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Alvarez <maria@stellar.solutions>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: Final acceptance latch & eSign sequencing (Stellar Solutions)

Hi Maria —

Attaching the updated MAP (v3) and a cleaned SOW draft for your review. We want to lock the final go/no-go and the signature routing this week so your team can hit the May 3 start date we talked about. Quick proposal:

- Week of Apr 12: Internal approvals and procurement PO creation
- Apr 14–15: DocuSign routing and signatures (two-step: Legal -> Ops lead)
- May 3: First day of onboarding (project kickoff)

Ask: could you confirm the signer list and when procurement will have the PO? Also flag any gating items on your side (SLA exceptions, compliance docs).

Attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx (tracker), SOW_draft_v2.pdf (redlines), signature_flow.png (proposed envelope order)

Thanks — I’ve assigned Dylan to prepare the eSign envelope and Kim will confirm pricing credits for the trial week.

Best,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_draft_v2.pdf (pdf), signature_flow.png (image)

From: Maria Alvarez <maria@stellar.solutions>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@stellar.solutions
Date: 2027-04-11T10:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Final acceptance latch & eSign sequencing (Stellar Solutions)

Thanks Priyom —

Received the MAP and SOW. Two quick notes from procurement/legal:

1) Signer list: Legal wants the contract signed by our GC first, then the Ops Director to accept the SOW. That means the DocuSign envelope should route GC -> Ops.
2) PO timing: procurement@ will spawn the PO once legal confirms the final SOW, usually a 48–72h turnaround after Legal sign-off. They will not issue a PO before GC signs the master terms.

We can aim for signatures by Apr 15 but I need to check with GC on availability — she is traveling Apr 13–14. If she signs Apr 15 morning we should be fine. Otherwise the earliest will slip to Apr 18.

Also: we require a short SLA exception for data retention on the sandbox. I attached our procurement intake (sent separately to procurement@).

On the SOW: I left a couple inline comments in SOW_draft_v2.pdf — nothing substantive, mostly clarifications on ramp metrics.

Best,
Maria
Maria Alvarez
Head of Partnerships, Stellar Solutions

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Alvarez <maria@stellar.solutions>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T12:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Final acceptance latch & eSign sequencing (Stellar Solutions)

Hi Maria — thanks for the callout. Quick plan from our side to handle the travel window and procurement requirement:

- We’ll create the DocuSign envelope with routing GC -> Ops. Dylan, can you prepare envelope with conditional routing and include the SOW final as a required attachment?
- Kimberly, please confirm the one-time trial credit (line item 3.2) so procurement sees the price that will go on the PO.
- If GC signs Apr 15 we proceed; if she signs Apr 18 we shift kickoff to May 6 to preserve two full onboarding weeks before May month-end checkpoints.

Dylan: I put the signature_flow.png in attachments — please include the flow and the two signature fields for clarity.

Maria: once GC confirms availability we’ll mark the MAP as "signature pending" and lock the SOW text that day — please reply-all with the final OK so procurement can start the PO.

Thanks — will hold on the DocuSign draft until Dylan confirms.

Cheers,
Priyom

From: procurement@stellar.solutions <procurement@stellar.solutions>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Maria Alvarez <maria@stellar.solutions>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T08:33:00Z
Subject: Re: Final acceptance latch & eSign sequencing (Stellar Solutions)

Hi all — procurement here. Confirming process: we will open a PO once Legal (GC) has executed the master terms. Expected turnaround is 2 business days from GC signature for the PO to be issued. Please ensure the SOW shows the exact billing start date and the invoice recipient.

Two items required from Redwood before we start:
- Final SOW PDF (signed-ready copy)
- Billing contact and tax info for Redwood (email + remit address)

If you can supply the signed-ready SOW in the DocuSign envelope (or provide a copy as soon as the GC signs), we’ll queue the PO.

Thanks —
Procurement Team
Stellar Solutions

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Alvarez <maria@stellar.solutions>, procurement@stellar.solutions
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-13T16:45:00Z
Subject: RE: Final acceptance latch & eSign sequencing (Stellar Solutions)

Update and final check —

- GC confirmed: she can sign Apr 15 morning. She sent a short ack to Maria just now.
- Dylan has prepared the DocuSign envelope (link below) with routing GC -> Ops and embedded SOW_draft_v2 (clean copy). Envelope includes fields for signatures and date.
- Kimberly confirms the trial credit (one-week free) and the pricing line is locked in the SOW (see redline).
- Procurement: once the DocuSign completes and GC signs, please issue the PO (2 business days).

DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-def456

Action items:
- Maria: please reply-all with a one-line confirmation that you approve the final SOW and the signature plan (so we have a written go/no-go).
- Procurement: queue the PO to issue upon GC signature.
- Dylan: send the envelope to Maria (GC) Apr 15 08:00 PT.

If I don’t hear a veto by EOD Apr 13 we’ll treat this as a greenlight to proceed with the envelope on Apr 15.

Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
